newsitem.title: USA: True North sees growth in 1997.
newsitem.headline: True North sees growth in 1997.

text.p: True North Communications Inc said Thursday it is in its strongest competitive position ever and expects the momentum to continue in 1997.
"By maintaining a consistent growth strategy, True North is in the strongest competitive position in its history," Bruce Mason, chairman and chief executive, said in a statement.
Earlier, True North reported fourth quarter earnings of $0.71 a share versus $0.67. Earnings for the year rose to $1.20 a share from $0.87. It said new business was strong.
"We expect this momentum to fuel our growth in 1997," Mason said.
True North is a global communications company. Its companies include the advertising agency Foote, Cone & Belding.
